title: Dental Reminder Flow - Confirm, Reschedule, Recover
description: A privacy-minimized dental appointment reminder and reschedule workflow.
headline: Give the front desk a response queue, not another list of calls.
subheadline: Prepare privacy-minimized reminders, classify confirmations and reschedules, and route every ambiguous response to a person.
buyer_signal: Front desks repeat the same reminder calls while juggling reschedules and pre-visit balance tasks in separate systems.
outcome: Every reminder produces a typed status or a staff-owned exception.
before: Staff call from spreadsheets, patients reply in free text, and reschedule or balance follow-up disappears between queues.
after: A scheduled, idempotent task prepares the approved reminder and routes each response to confirm, reschedule, stop, or staff review.

steps.name: Select
steps.detail: Read only eligible appointment tokens and consent state.

steps.name: Remind
steps.detail: Prepare approved copy without procedure details.

steps.name: Route
steps.detail: Classify confirm, reschedule, stop, or staff review.

steps.name: Follow-up
steps.detail: Create recall or reschedule tasks with receipts.

benefits.title: Reduce repetitive calls
benefits.detail: Staff work the exceptions instead of rebuilding the whole reminder list.

benefits.title: Keep privacy explicit
benefits.detail: Minimum fields, consent, BAAs, and patient-facing copy remain deployment gates.

benefits.title: Make responses actionable
benefits.detail: Every message state maps to one owner and next action.

faq.question: Is this HIPAA compliant out of the box?
faq.answer: No. Compliance depends on the practice's systems, contracts, BAAs, consent, configuration, and operating process; all remain pre-production gates.

faq.question: Does this starter send SMS messages?
faq.answer: No. It prepares provider-neutral payloads only and has no patient data or provider credentials.

faq.question: What happens to free-text replies?
faq.answer: Anything ambiguous or sensitive routes to staff; the workflow does not provide clinical advice.

faq.question: Does it collect patient balances?
faq.answer: No. It can create an approved staff handoff, but live payment links and charges are disabled.
